notes.title: The SteamVR Beta compatibility rollercoaster continues!
notes.content:
In an attempt to fix the compatibility issue FragmentVR was having with the SteamVR beta, the SteamVR devs released an update that was supposed to close the issue and nullify the need for the FragmentVR beta branch.

Unfortunately, the update broke compatibility completely, so now not even the FragmentVR beta branch works with SteamVR beta, and I can't do anything about it so we are going to have to wait for the SteamVR devs to push another update.

Sorry for the bumpy ride, let's hope this gets sorted out quickly! 

Quick recap on what's working and what's not:
- If you are on the main SteamVR build, the main FragmentVR build is working.
- If you are on the beta SteamVR build, no current build of FragmentVR is working.

notes.title: SteamVR compatibility issue fixed! -> Switch to FragmentVR beta branch
notes.content:
The source of the compatibility issue with the SteamVR beta branch has been found and fixed.

If you are on the SteamVR beta branch, then switch to the FragmentVR beta branch also.

notes.title: Prerelease Patch!
notes.content:
Some quality of life features have been added in right in time for release:

-Hide & Lock Corners toggle: Enabling this hides the corner logos and makes them unmovable
-Opacity Slider: Opacity can now be manually set
